phases.title: Repository foundation
phases.note: Repository structure, CI, privacy checks and public monitor are active.

phases.title: Canonicalize Apps Script baseline
phases.note: Complete privacy-audited Apps Script baseline is in the repo; DEFECT-001 is fixed in the repo baseline; production is unchanged.

phases.title: Baseline characterization tests
phases.note: Baseline characterization plus identity, context, queue/retry, transcript/artifact reuse and synthetic integration tests are active.

phases.title: Core contracts
phases.note: Core identities, contracts, state machines, schemas, provenance and runtime version identity are implemented.

phases.title: Context Resolver
phases.note: Context Resolver and arbitrary-folder regression path are implemented and tested.

phases.title: Registry projections
phases.note: Deterministic context manifests/JSONL registry projections are implemented; Drive write integration remains.

phases.title: Processor/provider boundaries
phases.note: Provider contracts, planner, queue/retry, source-faithful processors and Apps Script shadow bridge are implemented.

phases.title: Knowledge staging/retrieval
phases.note: Deterministic fusion, conflict records and metadata/lexical retrieval are implemented; semantic provider enrichment remains.

phases.title: Learner overlay/promotion
phases.note: Private learner-state and promotion policy helpers are implemented; private persistence integration remains.

phases.title: Repo-driven runtime deployment
phases.note: Repo-driven Apps Script build, Git build identity, integrity checks and shadow runtime bridge are implemented; production deployment remains gated.

phases.title: Real-source parity/release
phases.note: Synthetic end-to-end parity and repo-built runtime checks exist; live provider parity and rollback validation remain.
